digest.component_or_area: autodeploy disk-pressure reclaim and blue-green container retirement
propositions: Tagged blue-green images (compose-mcp:<sha>) accumulate indefinitely because docker image prune -f without -a removes only dangling images, leaving 10+ GB of reclaimable tagged-image storage
The reclaim gate reports success without measuring freed space, making it impossible to distinguish 'reclaim never ran' from 'reclaim ran and freed nothing' via the existing invocation counter

When a blue-green container is reaped, its per-release image (compose-mcp:<sha>) must be removed after successful docker rm, identified via docker inspect before container removal, while the live backend image and bare build tag are retained
Root-disk free space must be logged before and after every reclaim invocation with the delta, so reclaim effectiveness is observable rather than inferred

When disk pressure persists across 3+ consecutive reclaim cycles (PRESSURE_STREAK_ALARM), a distinct marker must be emitted to alert that reclaim is ineffective, decoupled from the per-invocation counter
